Australian MP faces allegations from One Nation leader

Liberal MP Andrew Hastie has stated he will engage in a "costly" fight with One Nation leader Pauline Hanson. Hastie's statement comes after allegations that he is a "traitor" to Australia, claims he says are being made because he provided evidence against Victoria Cross recipient Ben Roberts-Smith. One Nation's Victorian leader is also reportedly facing allegations of heavy drug use, with Hanson standing by the leader.
